{{Quote|I wish you well in the next life, infidel. The Heart of Dathomir is merciless to the unclean!|A [[Dark Veil Order]] pilot, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
The '''Heart of Dathomir''', fully known as the '''Heart of Dathomir Nebula''',<ref name="Sony" /> was a dense red-pulsating [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located near [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|29|Heart of Dathomir}}</ref> in the [[Dathomir's Vitality]] quadrant of the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]].<ref name="Sony" /> The Heart of Dathomir was revered by the sisters of the [[Dark Veil Order]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> who believed that the nebula had a mind of its own. Quick-killing assassins of the Order encircled the Heart of Dathomir, hoping to "sacrifice" unaware travelers to the nebula's powerful rage. Members of the Order believed the Heart of Dathomir nebula consumed the essence of those victims, fueling life into the palpitating mass and protecting the Dark Veil Order from infidels. The molten rocks and the red energy spilled from this dark cloud were thought to be infused with the rage of the souls lost in the nebula. Pilots traveling in the Dathomir system therefore avoided the infamous Heart of Dathomir.<ref name="Sony" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Heart of Dathomir appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Heart of Dathomir was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly stated that Dathomir's Vitality was a knot of rage located at the center of the Heart of Dathomir nebula.<ref name="TCSWE" /> In the game, Dathomir's Vitality was just the name of the space quadrant containing the nebula.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
